about: Questions about a new app. The setup skill does not walk the customer through them: it reads the answers the request gives, uses a question's `default` when the request does not answer it, and asks only a question marked "ask": true that the request does not answer (interactive), or returns those as needs_input (non-interactive) (skills/setup/SKILL.md, New app step 2). Each question has at most 4 options, the limit of Claude Code's question tool. Options with a product only appear when that product is in the plugin's scope. A question left with one option in scope is not asked: that option is its answer (for example `chat-ui` when UIKit is out of scope). There is no Calls-only app: an app with Calls always has Chat too. A question with "offered": false is a feature not offered in new-app setup for now: it is left out of the questions (set it to true or remove it to offer it again). A request that names that feature still gets it built, unless its product is not supported yet (config productScope.notYetSupported): that product is declined, never built.

options.label: Voice and video calls (always with Chat)
